summary: Settings file for the Next.js web framework that turns on React strict mode.
purpose: Tells Next.js how to build and run the app. This file only switches on React strict mode.
why: Strict mode makes React warn about risky code during development. Likely reason: it catches bugs early. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Next.js reads this file at start-up. It imports the type, sets the one option, and exports the result.
inputs: None from the user. Next.js reads the file itself.
outputs: A configuration object that Next.js uses for development and builds.
risks: Strict mode runs some effects twice in development. Code with side effects may behave differently in development than in production.
debug: If the app behaves oddly only in development, check whether strict mode is causing effects to run twice. Try removing the option temporarily to compare.
